citations.quote: Efficacy was established from one 12-week, phase 3 efficacy study **ALK9072-003**. design.text: 12-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, fixed-dose study; after establishing tolerability to oral aripiprazole, patients received oral aripiprazole or placebo daily for the first 3 weeks, with IM injections on Days 1, 29 and 57

citations.quote: In addition, the efficacy of ARISTADA was established in a 12-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, fixed-dose study in adult patients with schizophrenia meeting DSM-IV TR criteria [Study 1, n = 622; 207 (ARISTADA 441 mg), 208 (ARISTADA 882 mg), and 207 (placebo)]. After establishing tolerability to oral aripiprazole, patients received oral aripiprazole or placebo daily for the first 3 weeks. The intramuscular (IM) injections were administered on Days 1, 29 and 57.

population.text: Adult patients 18 to 70 years of age with schizophrenia (DSM-IV TR), PANSS total score of 70 to 120, experiencing an acute exacerbation of symptoms

citations.quote: Eligible patients were 18 to 70 years of age with PANSS total score of 70 to 120 and a score of \ge 4 for at least 2 of the selected Positive Scale items. Patients were also required to have a CGI-S score of \ge 4.

The applicant submitted one positive Phase 3, multiple-dose, multi-national, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study in patients experiencing an acute exacerbation of the symptoms of schizophrenia.

endpoint.text: Change from baseline to endpoint (Day 85) in PANSS total score

citations.quote: The primary efficacy variable was the change from baseline to endpoint (Day 85) in PANSS total score. Statistically significant separation from placebo on PANSS total score change was observed in each ARISTADA dose group (Table 11).

In addition, the efficacy of ARISTADA was established in a 12-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, fixed-dose study in adult patients with schizophrenia meeting DSM-IV TR criteria [Study 1, n = 622; 207 (ARISTADA 441 mg), 208 (ARISTADA 882 mg), and 207 (placebo)]. After establishing tolerability to oral aripiprazole, patients received oral aripiprazole or placebo daily for the first 3 weeks. The intramuscular (IM) injections were administered on Days 1, 29 and 57.

result.text: Placebo-subtracted PANSS total score change: ARISTADA 441 mg -10.9 (95% CI -14.5, -7.3); ARISTADA 882 mg -11.9 (95% CI -15.4, -8.3); both statistically significant vs placebo

target_moa.text: ARISTADA is a prodrug of aripiprazole; efficacy could be mediated through a combination of partial agonist activity at D2 and 5-HT1A receptors and antagonist activity at 5-HT2A receptors. Aripiprazole exhibits high affinity for dopamine D2 and D3, serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors.

citations.quote: ARISTADA is a prodrug of aripiprazole. Aripiprazole exhibits high affinity for dopamine D2 and D3, serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors (Ki values 0.34 nM, 0.8 nM, 1.7 nM, and 3.4 nM, respectively), moderate affinity for dopamine D4, serotonin 5-HT2C and 5-HT7, alpha1-adrenergic and histamine H1 receptors (Ki values 44 nM, 15 nM, 39 nM, 57 nM, and 61 nM, respectively), and moderate affinity for the serotonin reuptake site (Ki=98 nM).

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reaction (incidence >=5% and at least twice placebo) was akathisia (11% at both 441 mg and 882 mg vs 4% placebo). Other reactions >=2% include headache (882 mg 5% vs 3% placebo), injection site pain (3-4% vs 2%), and insomnia (3-4% vs 2%). Serious class risks: increased mortality in elderly dementia patients, cerebrovascular adverse reactions, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, tardive dyskinesia, and metabolic changes.

detail.text: Approved on first cycle (approval date October 5, 2015); no prior complete response letter for this application noted

citations.quote: This replacement approval letter incorporates the correction of the error. The effective approval date will remain October 5, 2015, the date of the original approval letter.

Please refer to your New Drug Application (NDA) dated August 22, 2014, received August 22, 2014, submitted pursuant to section 505(b)(2) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for Aristada (aripiprazole lauroxil) extended release injectable suspension 441 mg, 662 mg, and 882 mg.

summary.text: ARISTADA was approved October 5, 2015 as a 505(b)(2) NDA relying on the Agency's previous findings of safety and efficacy for Abilify (aripiprazole) Tablets. Efficacy was established in a single Phase 3 trial (ALK9072-003) plus pharmacokinetic bridging to oral aripiprazole. The application was not referred to an advisory committee because the drug is not first in its class; pediatric study requirements were waived.

citations.quote: This application was submitted as a 505(b)(2) NDA relying on the Agency's previous findings of safety and efficacy for Abilify (aripiprazole) Tablets (NDA 21436).
Your application for Aristada was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because this drug is not the first in its class.

We are waiving the pediatric study requirement for this application because necessary studies are impossible or highly impracticable. It is not feasible to conduct an adequate study of the safety and efficacy of aripiprazole lauroxil in a sufficient number of pediatric patients with schizophrenia due to the low prevalence, and the diagnostic difficulties and complexities in this population.

description.text: Added a higher 1064 mg strength enabling a every-2-month dosing interval

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a higher strength (1064 mg dose) of ARISTADA that extends the dosing interval to every 2 months.
